title: Social Media Post
description: Generate engaging, platform-aware social posts from a topic, product update, or news item.
template:
Write a social media post about [TOPIC OR NEWS ITEM].

Platform: [LINKEDIN / TWITTER / INSTAGRAM / TIKTOK / FACEBOOK]

Tone: [PROFESSIONAL / CASUAL / INSPIRATIONAL / HUMOROUS]

Goal: [INFORM / ENGAGE / PROMOTE / CELEBRATE]

Key message: [ONE OR TWO SENTENCES ON THE CORE IDEA]

Call to action: [E.G. LINK IN BIO / COMMENT BELOW / TAG A FRIEND]

Please provide:
- One primary post optimized for the platform
- One shorter alternative if the platform allows it
example:
Write a social media post about our team completing a major product redesign.

Platform: LINKEDIN

Tone: PROFESSIONAL

Goal: PROMOTE

Key message: Our checkout experience is now 30 percent faster and fully mobile-first.

Call to action: READ THE FULL CASE STUDY IN OUR BIO

Please provide:
- One primary post optimized for the platform
- One shorter alternative if the platform allows it
tips: Match the tone to your audience rather than your personal style
Add hashtags only when they genuinely expand reach
Test shorter vs longer versions with a small audience before posting
